content.text:
`python3 -m unittest -q` now passes (all 7 tests). I fixed two bugs in `household/bills.py` and changed one test's expected answer.

**Code fixes:**
1. **`split_bill` was losing the leftover cents.** It gave everyone the rounded-down share and dropped the remainder, so 1001 split 2 ways came to `[500, 500]`. Now the leftover cents go one each to the first people, as the docstring says, so the shares always add up to the full bill.
2. **`due_dates` crashed when payments ran into the next year.** It kept adding to the month number, which hit "bad month number 13". Now it rolls over into January of the next year.

**Test change:** `test_three_ways` expected `split_bill(1000, 3)` to be `[333, 333, 333]`. That only adds up to 999 cents, so it was only passing because of the first bug. It also disagreed with the docstring and with `test_remainder_goes_to_the_first`. I changed the expected answer to `[334, 333, 333]`. If you actually want the leftover cent to disappear, tell me and I'll change the code and the docstring instead.

Nothing is committed yet.
